definitions.force_rmse: Unfiltered true world Fz minus desired Fz, all 1 kHz logs; wrist measurement RMSE separately provided.
definitions.plot_sampled: Simulated Fz interpolated at the PDF force-polyline vertex times, trapezoid-weighted. Does not restore unpublished paper samples.
definitions.equilibrium_gap: norm(xi_xy + Fxy/400), descriptive quasi-static diagnostic, not the complete dynamic impedance equation.
definitions.integrated_impedance: L*(edot-edot0)+D*(e-e0)+integral(K*e+F-Fdes)dt, true Cartesian x/y, units N s.
definitions.high_frequency: Welch power in >=20 Hz band at 1 kHz; analysis only, no force filter in the feedback loop.
definitions.energy: Source-rule observed power. Algebraic cancellation is not a passivity proof for filtered, saturated, noisy, sampled, redundant robot dynamics.

paper.method: Native vector polylines via pdftocairo SVG; calibrated against axis grids.

beta.caveat: Statistics of the rendered polyline, NOT the 4 kHz internal beta signal.

trajectory.caveat: Timing inferred from shared export chunk boundaries; verify against PDF figure, not raw robot logs.

limitations: Plotted curves have approximately 10 ms spacing before exporter simplification.
Do not equate these curves with unpublished 1/4 kHz raw measurements.
RMSE and beta summaries describe the exported polylines; aliasing and pre-export decimation are unknown.
